name: US independent insurance agencies
icp: Independent P&C insurance agencies (commercial and/or personal lines) with roughly 3-40 staff, owner-led, using an agency management system. Commercial-lines agencies handle many certificate requests.
disqualifiers: Captive agents of a single carrier (State Farm, Allstate, Farmers office pages) since tooling is dictated by the carrier
Large national brokers or carriers themselves

pains.pain: Certificate-of-insurance (COI) requests handled manually by account managers
pains.solution: An agent that reads COI request emails, pulls policy details from the AMS, drafts the certificate and queues it for one-click approval
pains.evidence_to_look_for: Commercial lines focus (contractors, trucking, construction), 'request a certificate' pages, hiring CSRs/account managers

pains.pain: Renewal prep and remarketing done by re-keying data into carrier portals
pains.solution: Renewal pipeline that gathers exposure updates from clients, pre-fills submissions and summarizes carrier quotes side by side
pains.evidence_to_look_for: Many carrier logos, 'we shop multiple carriers', commercial focus

pains.pain: Slow quote intake from web forms and emails
pains.solution: Intake assistant that collects missing underwriting info by email/SMS and creates the prospect in the AMS
pains.evidence_to_look_for: Long quote forms, 'get a quote' CTAs, no online quoting

offer: A 2-4 week pilot automating one service workflow (usually COIs or quote intake) inside their existing AMS, with human approval
guarantee: If it doesn't give back at least 5 hours a week of account-manager time by day 30, they don't pay the monthly fee
mystery_shop: Submit the website quote form as a small business and time the reply
Email asking how to request a certificate of insurance and note the process
tone: Respectful, precise, uses agency vocabulary (COIs, AMS, renewals, remarketing, CSRs). Compliance-aware.
